allow: PowerShell($ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { $l=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://localhost:3001/login -TimeoutSec 40; Write-Output \("LOGIN HTTP "+$l.StatusCode+" bytes="+$l.Content.Length\) } catch { Write-Output \("LOGIN err "+$_.Exception.Message\) }; try { $d=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://localhost:3001/dashboard -TimeoutSec 40; Write-Output \("DASH HTTP "+$d.StatusCode\) } catch { Write-Output \("DASH err "+$_.Exception.Message\) })
PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; "frontend stopped")
